drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. Distorted, overdriven kick drum at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, metallic percussion loop provides high-frequency syncopation. A gritty, monophonic synth bassline plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with a low-pass filter sweep. Industrial sound effects, including metallic clangs and white noise bursts, are processed with short room reverb. A dark, atmospheric pad enters in the mid-section with a slow attack. The track features a minimalist, driving structure focused on rhythmic texture and timbral evolution rather than melodic progression.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, metallic percussion loop]

[Section A]
[monophonic synth bass enters with sixteenth-note pattern]
[white noise bursts, metallic clangs]

[Section B]
[low-pass filter opens on bassline]
[atmospheric synth pad swells]

[Outro]
[synth pad fades out]
[kick drum and percussion loop continue to end]

bass.tags: Funk rock instrumental. A clean, compressed electric guitar plays a syncopated 16th-note scratch riff with frequent palm muting and percussive rakes. The electric bass uses a bright, round tone, performing a repetitive slap-and-pop pattern that emphasizes the downbeat and the sixteenth-note subdivisions. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a punchy kick drum playing a syncopated funk pattern with ghost notes on the snare. A subtle wah-wah pedal effect is applied to a second rhythm guitar layer. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interlocking rhythmic relationship between the bass and the percussive guitar strumming.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[percussive muted electric guitar riff]
[slap bass enters with syncopated octaves]
[tight funk drum kit enters, dry snare]

[Main Theme]
[clean electric guitar plays rhythmic 16th-note chords]
[slap bass continues repetitive funk line]
[subtle wah-wah guitar flourishes in background]

[Bridge]
[bass becomes more melodic with slides]
[guitar shifts to sustained power chords with light overdrive]
[drum fills on toms]

[Outro]
[instruments gradually drop out]
[final percussive guitar rake]
